lines.t: Wake up early, gotta start the day right
Reading the Word, yeah, the future looking bright
Devil trying to trip me, but I'm skipping the trap
Got the armor of God, no gap in the wrap
Feeling like Samson, I'm breaking the chains
Swishing these blessings like LeBron in the lanes
People look at me like, "Who is this guy?"
Just a kid with a bible, but my spirit is high
Yeah, walking on water, no need for the floats
Got the Holy Ghost power, we the real life GOATs
We got the light and it’s shining so bright
Walking by faith, man, we living in the light
Yeah, we lifting Him high, no hands in our pockets
Blessings coming down like some aerospace rockets
Blessed up, stressed less, doing my best
Put the cross on my chest, let Him handle the rest
Man, the drive-thru line was a test of my grace
Had to pray for the worker with a smile on my face
They forgot my fries, but I didn't lose my cool
WWJD? Keep it smooth is the rule
I'm a fisher of men, got the net in the sea
But I still can't find where I left my car key
Yeah, we preaching the truth, we don't care about the trend
From the Genesis block all the way to the end
God did the math, yeah, He counted the hairs
Now I'm casting my burdens and dropping my cares
We got the light and it’s shining so bright
Walking by faith, man, we living in the light
Yeah, we lifting Him high, no hands in our pockets
Blessings coming down like some aerospace rockets
Blessed up, stressed less, doing my best
Put the cross on my chest, let Him handle the rest
Yeah, just a sinner saved by grace
Running this race at a steady pace
Keep the faith, keep the joy
Peace out.
